name: set-cookie-check
title: Set-Cookie Check
description: Stops cookies from being silently rejected or stolen by reading back what the browser will really do with each Set-Cookie (who gets it, over what, cross-site or not, and for how long after the 400-day cap) and flagging SameSite=None or Partitioned without Secure, broken __Host-/__Secure- prefixes, a Domain that shares a sign-in cookie with every subdomain, a missing HttpOnly, Expires and Max-Age that disagree and the 4096-byte limit, with one-tap fixes.
